Name: [CP] Artisanal Honey Mead
Author: Deathshift
TagLine: A small expansion to Mead, utilizing Jars of Honey from SVE and a vanilla recipe for non-SVE users.
Description:
What started as a small expansion to Jar of Honey from Stardew Valley Expanded specifically, grew into something more compatible for all Stardew Valley players. I have restructured the mod quite a bit, allowing users who do not play with SVE to create Honey Meads and advance them all the same!

Players can now also do a global toggle for the ability for recipes to copy quality of input/fuel. This is defaulted to auto/on if you have a 'Keeps Quality' mod installed.

I highly recommend checking out the wiki for more in-depth information about the mod!

Depends on Extra Machine Configs!
Now with Machine Progression System﻿ Support!
(If you do NOT have Machine Progression System installed SMAPI will throw yellow warnings, but you can ignore them. I highly recommend installing though, it can cut down crafting time significantly.)

Machine Progression Times:
-----------------------------------
[Artisanal Keg] {SVE} - 16 Hours - (2% Chance to Quadruple)
[Artisanal Keg] - 10 Hours - (5% Chance to Double)
[Vanilla Keg] - 8 Hours
[Gold Keg] - 7.2 Hours
[Diamond] - 6.4 Hours
[Iridium] - 5.8 Hours
[Radioactive] - 5.25 Hours
[Prismatic] - 4.7 Hours
-----------------------------------
[Vanilla Jar] - 50 hours/2.083 Days - (5% Chance to Double)
[Steel Jar] - 41 Hours/1.7 Days - (10% Chance to Double)
[Gold Jar] - 33 Hours/1.375 Days - (15% Chance to Double)
[Diamond Jar] - 25 Hours/1.04 Days - (20% Chance to Double)
[Iridium Jar] - 16 Hours - (25% Chance to Double)
[Radioactive Jar] - 16 Hours - (30% Chance to Double)
[Prismatic Jar] - 12 Hours - (35% Chance to Double)
-----------------------------------

Custom Machine - "Artisanal Mead Keg"

The Artisanal Mead Keg is unlocked at Farming Level 4﻿ - this does not operate as a standard keg so vanilla recipes will not work!
Crafting Cost:
125 Wood
2 Pine Tar
2 Oak Resin
You can purchase the blueprint for the Artisanal Mead Keg from Pierre before level 4 Farming for 50,000g!
Additionally, Pierre will sell 5 Artisanal Mead Kegs for 25,000g a piece!


If you do NOT have Stardew Valley Expanded installed, you will be able to craft Artisanal Honey Mead using this Keg! Brew time will be 10 Hours, with a 5% chance to double your Mead output! This recipe will cost 12x Honey. 

If you DO have Stardew Valley Expanded, you can use the Jar of Honey in this keg as well! It will take 16 hours with a 2% chance to Quadruple your mead!
﻿﻿﻿﻿
Stage Two:
You can now take your Bear Honey Mead, or Honey Mead and Two of any Three (Six Total) fruit over to the preserving jar to 'age' them!
(Modded fruits should work as long as their mod creator tagged them as fruit)
The mead has a random chance to take one of the 3 fruits as the primary focus, it will adopt the primary fruits' color.
*You must have the mead in your hand when placing into the Preserving Jar!

Check the wiki﻿ for a better breakdown of each stage of Machine Progression System!

Machine Progression System Preservation Jars!
﻿
These Aged Honey Meads can then be taken to your casks and further aged to perfection! Get Iridium quality to maximize your sell price and buffs! (or use higher quality fruits)﻿
